bullets.text: Microsoft Flight Simulator's New Mission - Players can engage in aerial firefighting with a mission inspired by the **New South Wales Rural Fire Service**.
Azure Expands Across Europe - **Microsoft Azure** is enhancing its infrastructure to meet the growing demand for cloud and AI services.
Xbox and Discord Unite - The partnership enhances **Xbox Game Pass** accessibility for **Discord Nitro** users, enriching gaming experiences.
New Windows Insider Builds Released - **Microsoft** continues to roll out new builds for Windows Insiders, enhancing user experience.
Dirty Frag Vulnerability Disclosed - A critical **Linux** vulnerability allows privilege escalation, posing significant security risks.
AI Framework Vulnerabilities Uncovered - **Microsoft** reveals critical vulnerabilities in AI agent frameworks, highlighting security risks in prompt injections.
Advancing Passwordless Authentication - **Microsoft** promotes passkey adoption to enhance security and reduce reliance on passwords.
Microsoft Leads in AI SOC - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in the emerging AI Security Operations Center market.
Free Microsoft Store Registration - Companies can now publish to the **Microsoft Store** with free registration and streamlined onboarding.
Azure Cosmos DB Insights - Lessons from **Azure Cosmos DB Conf 2026** highlight the importance of effective data modeling.
